title: Documentation System
summary: Formed from the shaped candidate. Wave 1 has one GitHub-tracked PAW-sized design-foundation spec; later waves are coarse sketch nodes pending builder gates and orchestrator promotion.

nodes.title: Documentation foundation design
nodes.summary: Define the documentation authority model, unified docs-site transition direction, and Streamliner product model for optional documentation families before implementation begins.

nodes.title: Documentation foundation gate
nodes.summary: Builder validates the documentation authority model, unified-site direction, and product-support model before implementation nodes are promoted.

nodes.title: Unified docs site and starter content
nodes.summary: Create the unified `docs/` site, preserve Design as the normative section, add initial User Guide and Architecture content, and update VitePress/scripts/publish behavior as needed.

nodes.title: Published docs site validation
nodes.summary: Builder validates that the unified docs site builds, navigates, preserves Design authority, and has useful starter User Guide and Architecture content.

nodes.title: Documentation family product support
nodes.summary: Teach Streamliner to discover documentation families, represent optional documentation hints, flow them into worker context, and capture worker/reconciliation documentation impact.

nodes.title: Documentation system closure review
nodes.summary: Builder validates the published documentation system and product support end-to-end, accepts declared exports, and decides whether the workstream can close.

checkpoints.title: Documentation foundation aligned
checkpoints.summary: The documentation taxonomy, unified-site direction, and product-support model are explicit enough to guide implementation.

checkpoints.title: Unified docs site usable
checkpoints.summary: The `docs/` site builds and contains navigable Design, Architecture, and User Guide sections with useful starter content.

checkpoints.title: Documentation families flowing
checkpoints.summary: Streamliner can discover optional documentation families, represent them in workstream context, and capture worker documentation impact.

checkpoints.title: Documentation system closure ready
checkpoints.summary: All planned workstream outputs have been validated and the builder can close or extend the workstream.
